documentation.content: More than 10 questions were refused in an hour. Refusing is correct for questions the handbook does not cover, so this is not automatically a fault. It is the signal that retrieval may have broken: an empty or unreachable corpus makes every question refuse with reason no_evidence. Check the abstention_reason field of the query events and the corpus check on /ready.

conditions.displayName: More than 10 refusals in an hour
